normalized_target_comparison: Atlas models a directed complete vertex-pair capacity matrix with independent ordered-pair capacities and permits simultaneous opposite-direction flows; the frozen target uses an undirected Graph V E with explicit arc identities, including parallel arcs, and each arc's one capacity is shared by traversal in either direction.
Atlas capacities and edge flows are Real and merely nonnegative; the frozen target uses strictly positive NNReal capacity on graph arcs and a Finsupp collection of weighted simple chains.
Atlas STCut is a vertex partition; the frozen target asks for a disconnecting Finset of graph arcs meeting every source-to-sink chain.

Atlas max_flow_min_cut itself assumes a supplied STFlow with NoAugmentingPath and produces one equal-capacity cut. The frozen target proves existence of a feasible flow and cut and includes explicit maximum and minimum universal comparison clauses. Atlas's separate exists_maxFlow lead might compose with its weak/strong directed results, but that larger dependency boundary was not replayed or transitively audited here.
No checked transport connects the directed conservation encoding, flow/cut values, no-augmenting-path premise, or vertex partition to the frozen 1956 encoding.
